color_at.label: Read one pixel from memory
color_at.description: Read the RGB color at (123, 456) in an image already loaded into memory. This does not take a screenshot.
color_at.caveat: Tiny calls include API wrapper and return-value costs.

find_color_early.label: Find a color at the start
find_color_early.description: Find the first black pixel at the start of the 1920 × 1080 image. The search can stop immediately.
find_color_early.caveat: Best-case search, not a full-image scan.

find_color_late.label: Find a color near the end
find_color_late.description: Find magenta at (1856, 1016), near the bottom-right of a 1920 × 1080 image. Most pixels must be checked.
find_color_late.caveat: One match is returned; this avoids the cost of a large result collection.

find_color_absent.label: Search for a missing color
find_color_absent.description: Search the entire 1920 × 1080 image for cyan, which is absent. Both implementations must return no match.
find_color_absent.caveat: Measures a full scan with no result collection.

count_color_absent.label: Count a color that is absent
count_color_absent.description: Scan the 1920 × 1080 image and return zero matching pixels.
count_color_absent.caveat: Counting checks the whole search area.

count_color_dense.label: Count 65,536 matching pixels
count_color_dense.description: Every pixel in a uniform 256 × 256 image matches. Return the count, 65,536.
count_color_dense.caveat: Returns one number, not a list of positions.

find_colors_dense.label: Return 65,536 pixel positions
find_colors_dense.description: Search a uniform 256 × 256 image and return every matching pixel position.
find_colors_dense.caveat: Includes allocation: Rust returns a vector; RobotJS builds JavaScript objects. The ratio is not scan speed alone.

find_image_late.label: Find an image near the end
find_image_late.description: Locate a 32 × 32 template at (1856, 1016) inside a 1920 × 1080 image. Return the first match.
find_image_late.caveat: Exact matching; archived Node/Rust round ranges overlap.

find_image_absent.label: Search for a missing image
find_image_absent.description: Look for a 32 × 32 template that does not occur in the 1920 × 1080 source.
find_image_absent.caveat: Exact matching; archived Node/Rust round ranges overlap.

find_image_tolerant.label: Find an image with color tolerance
find_image_tolerant.description: Find the planted 32 × 32 template with a color tolerance of 0.02, allowing small color differences.
find_image_tolerant.caveat: Approximate matching requires extra color-distance arithmetic.

count_image_dense.label: Count overlapping image matches
count_image_dense.description: Count all 64,009 placements of a matching 4 × 4 tile in a uniform 256 × 256 image.
count_image_dense.caveat: Overlapping matches count. Returns one number.

find_images_dense.label: Return 64,009 image positions
find_images_dense.description: Return all 64,009 positions of a matching 4 × 4 tile in a uniform 256 × 256 image.
find_images_dense.caveat: Includes allocation of the complete collection of positions.

load_bmp.label: Load a BMP image
load_bmp.description: Read and decode the same 1920 × 1080 BMP file into a pixel buffer.
load_bmp.caveat: Warmed file cache. Rust produces BGRA32; RobotJS produces the smaller BGR24 buffer.

load_png.label: Load a PNG image
load_png.description: Read and decode the same 1920 × 1080 PNG file into a pixel buffer.
load_png.caveat: Warmed file cache; decoded buffer formats differ.

save_bmp.label: Save a BMP image
save_bmp.description: Encode and write the 1920 × 1080 image as BMP.
save_bmp.caveat: Rust writes BMP24; RobotJS writes BMP32. No fsync: durable storage completion is not timed.

save_png.label: Save a PNG image
save_png.description: Encode and write the 1920 × 1080 image as PNG using each API’s defaults.
save_png.caveat: Output sizes differ. No fsync. Archived Node/Rust round ranges overlap.

get_mouse_pos.label: Read the pointer position
get_mouse_pos.description: Ask the operating system for the current pointer coordinates.
get_mouse_pos.caveat: Does not move the pointer or measure input delivery.

get_displays.label: List connected displays
get_displays.description: Ask for the list of displays and consume the returned count.

get_pixel_color.label: Capture one screen pixel
get_pixel_color.description: Capture the current screen color at desktop coordinate (0, 0).
get_pixel_color.caveat: October 27 capture implementation, before the later Rust optimization. Different OS capture backends.

capture_small.label: Capture a 100 × 100 region
capture_small.description: Take a fresh screenshot of the 100 × 100 rectangle at the display’s top-left.
capture_small.caveat: October 27 capture implementation, before the later Rust optimization. No encoding or network transport.

capture_full.label: Capture the whole display
capture_full.description: Capture the main display at its 1920 × 1080 logical dimensions.
capture_full.caveat: October 27 capture implementation. Archived round ranges overlap; the small median advantage is uncertain.
